# convert.in

> Image and PDF tools that run entirely in the browser. Files are read, converted and written on the visitor's own machine; nothing is uploaded, and there is no server behind the app.

## Docs

- [The app](https://convertin.kevinpradith.my.id): one hosted copy, the same static build this repository produces.

- [README](https://github.com/kevinpradith/convert.in#readme): what the tools do, how the browser app and the CLI share one core, and how to run either.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/kevinpradith/convert.in/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): how to build, test and send a change.
- [Security policy](https://github.com/kevinpradith/convert.in/blob/main/SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/kevinpradith/convert.in/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): what changed in each release.
- [Licence](https://github.com/kevinpradith/convert.in/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT.
